title: Tool Selection For Repairs
definition: The concept of selecting the appropriate tools for specific repair jobs, considering the material properties, drilling techniques, and the advantages of specialized tools.

difficulty_levels.beginner: To repair hard items, use the right tool. Drill bits for hardened steel need to be slow and strong. Left-hand drill bits can help remove broken bolts more easily.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: For repairing hardened steel, use carbide or cobalt drill bits. These are harder than standard bits and can cut through the material effectively. Left-hand drill bits work by drilling a pilot hole and trying to unscrew the bolt at the same time.
difficulty_levels.expert: The selection of tools for repair jobs is a complex decision that involves understanding material properties and appropriate drilling techniques. For hardened steel, carbide and cobalt drill bits are preferred due to their hardness and heat resistance. Left-hand drill bits offer an alternative approach by drilling a pilot hole and applying counter-clockwise torque to unscrew the bolt. This approach has its limitations and may not work with all keyless chucks.

extra_fields.insight: The use of carbide or cobalt drill bits and left-hand drill bits can significantly improve the effectiveness and efficiency of repair jobs, especially when dealing with hardened steel and broken bolts.
